description: Per-task, per-stage cascade skip (design section 4, Jay's semantics: a skipped stage contributes an IDENTITY transform and later stages still run on the un-pre-warped inputs; independent draws per stage/task/step; never in validation). New --cascade-skip-linear / --cascade-skip-deform 'level:prob' specs (rigid and affine share the linear spec), stage mode in the Trainer with a [n_stages] bool skip input, new FrozenChain.linear_skip / deform_skip, provenance + level-1 skip-consistency WARNING in main.py, stage-mode check in check_mixed_run.py. Legacy --cascade-skip-prob keeps its code path verbatim; defaults (no specs) build no skip op -> goldens and tests.test_cascade.TestSkip bit-exact. Independent of FEAT-001/002; FEAT-004 also edits runtime/run.py::fit and runtime/args.py, so do FEAT-003 first and keep edits localized.
steps: runtime/args.py (cascade group near --cascade-skip-prob l.376): add --cascade-skip-linear SPEC and --cascade-skip-deform SPEC (type str, default None). Parser function `parse_skip_spec(text, flag, levels)` -> {level:int: p:float}: comma list 'level:prob', empty string -> {} (all 0), level must be in `levels`, p finite in [0, 1), no duplicates, malformed -> ValueError naming the flag and the entry. In parse_args, in this order: any non-None spec without --cascade-from -> parser.error('--cascade-skip-linear needs --cascade-from') (resp. -deform) - this runs before the level check so --level 4 always gets this message; frozen levels = [4] at --level 2, [4, 2] at --level 1; parse; legacy --cascade-skip-prob > 0 together with any per-stage p > 0 -> parser.error('--cascade-skip-prob and --cascade-skip-linear / --cascade-skip-deform are mutually exclusive'). Store args.cascade_skip_stage_parsed = {task: {lv: p}} for the TRAINED tasks only (rigid/affine from the linear spec, deform from the deform spec; unlisted levels 0). train_config_from_args passes cascade_skip_stage=args.cascade_skip_stage_parsed. Note args_to_dict writes int keys -> JSON string keys (fine).

runtime/run.py: TrainConfig.cascade_skip_stage: Dict[str, Dict[int, float]] = dataclasses.field(default_factory=dict). Add pure function `cascade_stage_skip_draw(seed, step, task, level, p)` = False if p == 0 else random.Random('cascade-skip-%s-l%d-%d-%d' % (task, level, seed, step)).random() < p. Keep cascade_skip_draw verbatim. In Trainer.__init__ (cascade checks ~l.540): self._frozen_levels = [4] if n_stages == 1 else [4, 2]; validate cascade_skip_stage (levels subset of frozen levels, p in [0,1), both legacy p > 0 and any stage p > 0 -> ValueError; stage spec without a cascade -> ValueError); self._skip_mode = 'legacy' if cascade_skip_prob > 0 else ('stage' if any stage p > 0 else 'off').

runtime/run.py step builders (deform body ~l.690-780, linear body ~l.795-900): legacy/off branches unchanged. Stage mode: skip input is tf.TensorSpec([n_stages], tf.bool) (index i = self._frozen_levels[i]); trace-time on4 = p[task].get(4, 0) > 0, on2 = p[task].get(2, 0) > 0. Level 2 (FrozenStage): if on4: A_prev = CS.skip_linear(skip[0], A_prev) / U, U_inv = CS.skip_fields(skip[0], [U, U_inv]) (same ops as legacy). Level 1 (FrozenChain): A_prev = cascade.linear_skip(images, task, skip4=skip[0] if on4 else None, skip2=skip[1] if on2 else None); deform: prev = cascade.deform_skip(images, skip4=..., skip2=...). Tasks with every p == 0 in stage mode build no cascade_skip op (still take the [n_stages] input). One trace per task regardless of values.

models/cascade.py: add FrozenChain.linear_skip(images_l1, task, skip4=None, skip2=None) and deform_skip(images_l1, skip4=None, skip2=None) exactly as the sketch in design 4.4 (skip_linear on A4, prewarp_linear(x2, A4, P.LEVEL_SPACING[CHAIN_LEVEL]), model2 eval forward, compose_linear(out['A_raw'], A4, self.model2.centering), skip_to(skip2, A4, A2); deform: skip_fields on U4/U4i before prewarp_deform, diffeo.compose_cascade, upsample, skip_to(skip2, up(U4), U) etc.; stop_gradient on outputs; float32 rules as _linear/_deform). Reuse _linear / _deform code paths so that skip4=None yields identical ops to linear_stages / deform_stages + skip_to.

runtime/run.py train_step(task, batch_tuple, skip=False): stage mode requires a tuple/list of n_stages bools (bare bool -> TypeError) and feeds tf.constant(list, tf.bool); legacy/off unchanged. fit(): stage mode draws skips = tuple(cascade_stage_skip_draw(cfg.seed, s, task, lv, p[task].get(lv, 0)) for lv in self._frozen_levels); rec['cascade_skip_l%d' % lv] = bool for lv with p > 0 for this task; acc.update({'train_%s/cascade_skip_l%d' % (task, lv): float(skip)}). Legacy key train/cascade_skip_frac only in legacy mode. BN recalibration and validation untouched (no skip input).

main.py: cascade record (fresh: both the chain l.~312 and FrozenStage l.~335 branches) gains 'skip_mode' ('off'|'legacy'|'stage') and in stage mode 'skip_probs' {task: {'4': p, '2': p}} (string keys), plus 'skip_consistency_warnings'. Pure helper `_skip_consistency(src_cascade_rec, skip_stage_parsed) -> list of task names` (design 4.5: for every task with p4 > 0, warn when the level-2 source's cascade.skip_probs[task]['4'] is missing/0; legacy source skip_prob > 0 counts as trained for every task; src None -> []); at --level 1 call it with src_info['upstream_cascade'] (already loaded) and print `WARNING: --cascade-skip- skips level 4 for but the level-2 source was trained with level-4 skip p =

for it; the frozen level-2 stage will see out-of-distribution inputs`. Resume (cascade_rec = saved_cfg['cascade'] l.290): refresh skip_mode / skip_probs / skip_consistency_warnings from the current flags (everything else carried) and when any differs log event {'event': 'cascade_skip_changed_on_resume', 'old', 'new'}.

tests/gpu/check_mixed_run.py: _check_skip(recs, cfg): if config.json cascade.skip_mode == 'stage', require every train_/cascade_skip_l with p > 0 (from cascade.skip_probs) logged and finite at least once and print `INFO skip l: observed vs p

` (never a failure); else today's legacy check verbatim. Update docstring.

'4:0' and '' without --cascade-from also at --level 4, legacy + stage both) and resume refresh/event; 11.3 g `_skip_consistency` cases. tests/test_check_mixed_run.py: stage-mode skip check passes with keys present, fails when a p > 0 key is missing. Existing TestSkip must pass UNMODIFIED.

Default runs (no skip specs) build no cascade_skip op; goldens max |diff| 0

Stage-mode skip semantics match design 4.1 (skip 4 keeps level 2 running on identity-pre-warped inputs; skip both = identity)
